title: evbuilder-object-event-items.md
content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Event Items ## slug: evbuilder-object-event-items ## seoTitle: Event Items ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The following updates were made to the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} object. ## Functionality The {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} automatically creates {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s based on the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventLocation}}. The picklist options for the {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventLocation}} are “Venue”, “Virtual”, and “Hybrid”. ## Venue Event When a user creates a new Venue {{variable.Object_Event}} and clicks {{variable.button_new}} on the Ticket section, a new, free {{variable.Object_EventItem}} with {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event ticket” will be created. The {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PublicItemNa}} will be “Main Ticket {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}}”. ## Virtual Event When a user creates a new Virtual {{variable.Object_Event}} and clicks {{variable.button_new}} on the Ticket section, a new free {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event ticket” will be created. The {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PublicItemNa}} will be “Main Ticket {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}}”. ## Hybrid Event When a user creates a new Hybrid {{variable.Object_Event}} and clicks {{variable.button_new}} on the Ticket section, two new {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s will be created. * A free {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event ticket” will be created. The {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PublicItemNa}} will be “Venue Main Ticket {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}}”. * A free {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event ticket” will be created. The {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PublicItemNa}} will be “Virtual Main Ticket {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}}”.
